name: Akçansa Çimento Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
summary: Akçansa Çimento Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells cement, clinker, ready-mix concrete, and aggregates in Turkey and internationally. The company operates in Cement and Ready-Mix Concrete segments. It offers products under the Akçansa, Agregasa, and Betonsa brands. The company also provides port services. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey. As of June 18, 2026, Akçansa Çimento Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Heidelberg Materials AG.
